name: Site Memory Inspector
author: SnappaGuy

sections.description:
Monitor your WordPress memory usage with a clean, lightweight dashboard.

Site Memory Inspector helps you monitor your website memory usage in real time.

Site Memory Inspector is designed to stay lightweight and fast.

No telemetry, tracking, external API requests, heavy JavaScript frameworks, or scheduled background tasks.

Site Memory Inspector works immediately after activation with no complicated setup required.

Features:

  • Real-time memory usage dashboard.
  • Health status indicators.
  • Live admin bar memory indicator.
  • Dashboard widget.
  • Copy server report.
  • Admin memory threshold alerts.
  • Lightweight and fast.

Why Use Site Memory Inspector?

High memory usage can cause:

  • failed plugin updates.
  • slow admin pages.
  • backup failures.
  • WooCommerce instability.
  • white screen errors.

Site Memory Inspector helps you quickly understand whether your site memory usage is healthy.

Built for WordPress users who want a simple, modern, and lightweight way to monitor memory health.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the memory-health folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Site Memory Inspector from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Site Memory Inspector in the WordPress admin sidebar.
sections.faq:
Does Site Memory Inspector track data?

No. Site Memory Inspector does not send telemetry, tracking data, or external API requests.

Does Site Memory Inspector store historical memory data?

No. Current versions focus on current memory usage, peak usage, health status, server information, and a copyable report.

Who can view Site Memory Inspector?

Administrators with the manage_options capability can access Site Memory Inspector.
